extracted.intended_audience: readers of classic satirical Renaissance prose (Rabelais translation); literature students and general readers interested in humor/satire
extracted.subtask_description: A chunk of translated Renaissance satirical prose (from Rabelais) presenting humorous digressions on lending, marriage, bodily metaphor, and codpieces; intended as literary entertainment and social commentary rather than instruction. Useful for readers studying comic rhetoric, parody, and early-modern satire.
